_readme: One entry per third-party asset or text. Status: 'owned' = the authors own it, usable on the site; 'cleared' = used only in the context the book used it (BRIEF §2.1); 'blocked' = never use; 'on-hold' = do not use until ownership is confirmed; 'not-owned' = we do not hold the rights. evidence is still empty for every entry: add the paperwork reference when Mark has it.

assets.scope: Not owned by the authors. Do not copy the 2010 interior layout or page designs. The same colors and typefaces may be used. If the actual typefaces are used (the 2010 book was set in Swiss 721 BT), check that a web font license exists, because a print license does not cover web use.
